profile.headline: Technical Lead | Software Eng | Cloud Computing | Open Source | DevOps | Infrastructure-as-Code | Kubernetes | OpenStack | Telco | AI Agents
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer with 20+ years of experience building scalable systems across cloud infrastructure, cloud-native networking, developer platforms, and AI-native development.

Throughout my career, I’ve focused on reducing friction—making complex technologies easier to build, operate, adopt, and scale while reducing cost and cognitive load.

I’ve helped telecom operators adopt cloud-native technologies for 5G and enabled developers to move faster from code to production through DevOps and platform engineering. I also enjoy helping students and emerging technologists grow through mentorship and community building.

My work spans both proprietary and open-source ecosystems. I’ve contributed code, best practices, and technical leadership to projects across OpenInfra, CNCF, ONAP, and LFN. I enjoy working at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and strategy to turn complex challenges into platforms that help teams solve problems at scale.

Technology is ultimately about people. That belief has led me to co-found OpenStackGDL, Cloud-Native El Salvador, and other technology communities in Guadalajara. I’m also part of the organizing committee for KCD Guadalajara. Through these communities, I speak at technical conferences across LATAM.

Today, I’m bringing this experience to AI-native developer platforms—connecting AI with the code, context, tools, and workflows engineers need to be more productive and make better decisions.

My goal is simple: enrich people’s lives by making technology work better for them.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Every Walmart engineer should be able to develop faster and more reliably with AI. That is why I helped create a unified MCP registry and a codebase knowledge platform for AI tools. Today, 25K+ developers find MCP servers in one place, AI tools get better context from 19K+ repositories.

• Unified MCP server discovery for 25K+ developers across ~275 production and 1.7K+ non-production servers, by architecting MetaRegistry, a platform that merges legacy registries using dynamic metadata aligned with the open-source SEP-2127 MCP Server Cards proposal.
• Onboarded 10+ external local STDIO MCP servers into the central platform, by designing a GitOps workflow built on the open MCP Registry server.json specification.
• Accelerated MCP adoption across 30K+ Walmart Global Tech employees, by building an end-to-end developer platform for server creation, deployment, and registration, with tooling, documentation, and real-world Agent AI examples.
• Reduced AI hallucinations and raised developer trust across 19K+ repositories, by delivering a platform that regenerates a codebase knowledge repository from every code change so AI tools load relevant local context.
• Simplified microservice deployment and service isolation across teams, by driving architecture reviews that established scalable patterns and engineering standards.
positions.insights: Skills: LangChain · Ollama · Devcontainers · CrewAI · Model Context Protocol

positions.description: Led end-to-end execution of Kubernetes Community Days Guadalajara, aligning teams and streamlining operations to deliver a seamless event.

positions.title: Community Collaborator
positions.description:
Facilitated the integration and creation of Spanish speaking technical communities.

• Established the Cloud-Native community in El Salvador and provided remote support to the Cloud-Native Guadalajara community. 
• Presented as a speaker at KCDs and meetups across Spain, Guatemala, Costa Rica, Mexico, El Salvador, and Colombia.
• Nominated CNCF Ambassador during the Fall 2023 term.

positions.title: Contributor
positions.description:
Collaborated with the stability and usage of CNCF projects.

• Expanded the CRI-O Container Manager support of Kubespray project, adding multiple runtimes(crun, kata, youki).
• Consolidated efforts for the translation of CNCF documentation to Spanish. Recognized with the approver's role in Kubernetes Website and CNCF Glossary projects.
• Shaped CNF development best practices and earned the CNF Developer Co-Chair nomination, by driving proposals in the CNCF CNF Working Group.

positions.title: Technical Steering Committee (TSC) Member
positions.description:
Contributed to the project's success by leveraging technical expertise and strategic thinking.

• Represented Samsung on the Nephio Technical Steering Committee and organized internal contributions to the project.
• Participated in community discussions to drive growth and success of the project.

positions.title: Contributor
positions.description:
Played a key role in ensuring the reliability and functionality of the system.

• Became the top Nephio contributor in R2 (10.68% of contributions) and earned a Technical Steering Committee seat (Oct 2022 to May 2024), by leading end-to-end testing and shipping 11K+ lines of CI/CD and test changes covering Free5GC and OAI on Ubuntu and Fedora.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Telco solutions should not be expensive and complex to deploy. So I focused on open-source testing, CI, and CNF standards. As a result, I became the top Nephio contributor and a TSC member, helped shape CNF best practices in the CNCF.

• Represented Samsung on the Nephio Technical Steering Committee and organized internal contributions to the project.
• Established a reference for future CNF projects, by launching the gw-tester Core Network[1] project
• Improved CNF portability and deployment efficiency, by developing the NSM Generic Sidecar[2] and a webhook injector server[3].
• Curated CFP submissions for three Cloud Native Telco Day events (North America 2023, Europe 2022 and 2023), by serving on the Program Committee.
• Improved the quality of the Linux Foundation LFS179 Introduction to Nephio course, by reviewing its training material.
• Attained the Samsung Research America award for the Matter project contributions.

[1] https://github.com/gw-tester/
[2] https://github.com/gw-tester/nse
[3] https://github.com/gw-tester/nse-injector-webhook

• Automated provisioning for the Distributed Compliance Ledger project, reducing end-to-end provisioning time from hours to minutes.

Working at OPNFV, I collaborated with a team to ensure the project met industry standards and implemented efficient coding practices.

positions.title: Senior Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with external customers on maximizing performance on their Cloud-Native solutions using Intel Technologies.

• Automated[1] complex Kubernetes configuration of Intel(r) QuickAssist accelerator, boosting HTTPS request speed by 50%.
• Demonstrated[2] Suspend/Resume VM actions in a Kubernetes cluster to meet a key external customer requirement.
• Enhanced customer understanding of PriorityClass definition in NonPreempting Kubernetes cluster[3], aiding in smoother operations for external clients.
• Integrated[4] Intel(r) QuickAssist accelerator in HAProxy OpenShift Router, proving its viability in next coming OpenShift releases.
• Demonstrated[5] a 4x cost reduction per iteration using CPU with PyTorch for Deep Learning performance, highlighting cost-effective solutions in technology advancements.

[1] https://github.com/intel/kubernetes-qat-envoy/tree/master/vagrant
[2] https://github.com/electrocucaracha/k8s-SuspendResume-demo
[3] https://github.com/electrocucaracha/k8s-NonPreemptingPriority-demo
[4] https://github.com/electrocucaracha/okd
[5] https://github.com/electrocucaracha/dlrs

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
Kubernetes must be a real option for telco VNFs, and customers should get the most benefit from Intel technology. Therefore, I led the ONAP Kubernetes integration and built customer proofs of concept. This earned a Committer role in ONAP.

• Accelerated VNF component validation, by creating the Kubernetes Reference Deployment (krd) project[1].
• Enabled VNF management in Kubernetes, by leading 4+ engineers to deliver the MultiCloud/K8s Go plugin[2].
• Raised MultiCloud/OpenStack plugin unit-test coverage above 67% and earned the MultiCloud Committer role, by writing and improving tests.
• Found 20+ bugs in four months and simplified ONAP environment setup, by building the integration-devtool Vagrant tool.
• Extended OPNFV XCI to corporate networks and drove its re-architecture, by implementing Kolla as an additional OpenStack installer and aligning maintainers for Cross Community CI recognition.

[1] https://github.com/electrocucaracha/krd
[2] https://github.com/shank7485/k8-plugin-multicloud

positions.title: Open Source Engineer
positions.description:
OpenStack must be ready for enterprise use. So I took industry concerns to the upstream community and contributed code, reviews, and mentoring. As a result, 12,000+ SLOC were approved, 750+ changes reviewed, Rolling Upgrades were delivered in Neutron, and Intel became a top 10 contributor.

• Strengthened Neutron, Devstack, Horizon, Glance, Oslo, and Keystone (Havana to Pike), by approving 12,000+ SLOC and reviewing 750+ changes.
• Delivered Rolling Upgrades in Neutron, by reviewing 650+ changes and submitting 65+ patches.
• Unblocked project execution, by reporting six critical bugs.
• Simplified Tricircle user management and earned Core Contributor status, by building python-tricircleclient[1], a production-ready Python CLI and client.
• Positioned Intel among the top 10 OpenStack contributors, by leading and mentoring its engineer

[1] https://github.com/openstack-archive/python-tricircleclient

positions.title: Project Lead
positions.description:
Clear Linux (https://clearlinux.org/) should be a top distribution choice for cloud deployments. So I led the team and trained engineers new to cloud. Together, we delivered 300+ OpenStack packages and cut VM boot time in half.. 

• Delivered 300+ RPM packages for OpenStack services on Clear Linux, by leading 7+ QA and cloud engineers with Agile practices.
• Halved VM boot time versus other distributions, by orchestrating a dedicated task force.
• Ramped up engineers new to cloud computing, by training them on OpenStack.

positions.title: Cloud Software Engineer
positions.description:
Intel's internal IT hosting should modernize and embrace cloud technologies. So I worked on OpenStack adoption, internal cloud optimization, and automation. As a result, 6K+ VMs were migrated to an internal OpenStack deployment, with lower host resource use and faster database provisioning.

• Migrated an internal cloud of 6K+ VMs to OpenStack, by contributing to the deployment and customizing provisioning to internal IT policies.
• Reduced CPU and memory use on ESX hosts, by optimizing ASP.NET code.
• Improved cloud visibility, by extending the dashboard with customized monitoring.

positions.title: Hosting Software Engineer
positions.description:
Redesigned internal hosting solutions used for the installation and configuration of MS SQL products.

• Redesigned internal hosting solutions for MS SQL products, improving code reuse and expanding support to other products.
• Introduced a WPF application for faster installation and setup of Microsoft DB products (Mirroring, HADR and MS SQL AlwaysOn) through WMI protocol.
• Provided internal customer support for MS SQL Server installation/configuration issues.

positions.title: Contributor
positions.description:
Participated on the containerization of Virtual Network Functions (VNFs) and improved the quality of code for several ONAP projects.

• Led the implementation of the ONAP MultiCloud/K8s plugin, addressing challenges faced by VNFs in Cloud-Native workloads.
• Developed the Devtool tool[1], detecting +20 bugs in four months and accelerating ONAP development environment provisioning.
• Promoted as MultiCloud Committer in the ONAP community for contributions to containerization of VNFs.

[1] https://github.com/onap/integration-devtool
